decision: Do not ship Q4K GPU for the 0.8B model: no >=5% prefill gain; every requested prefill median regresses. Keep default GPU=0 and installed t010 unchanged.

method.warmup: min(prompt,64) tokens + min(n_gen,4) generated tokens, outside timing; n_gen=0 for prompt-only runs
method.load: C pinfer_load only, no tokenizer; excluded from prefill/decode timing

host_gates.check_lib: host and aarch64 pass; required GLIBC 2.34 <= Pi 2.41

private_q4_regression.raw: Private ignored cerno-* result retained in root results, not copied here

profile_observation: Single diagnostic pair, not headline speed: two p64 prefills including warmup, matmul total 2411.1ms CPU vs 2475.1ms GPU. qkv improves, 2048x1024 / 1024x2048 / down regress. Head is n1 in prompt-only last-logit evaluation and stays CPU; all-logit PPL exercises its batched GPU path. Per-stage GPU overhead not separately measured.
